note: [agent-bulk] numucc_em. Vertex is good: at el+60 the star is a clean two-prong V -- a long straight track running one way (14004, pdg 13, 37.7 cm) and a second prong the other (14028, pdg 2212, 22.4 cm) -- and the same kink is visible at az-055. shw 60025 (298.4 MeV, 10 seg, 67.5 cm, conn 2) starts ~18 cm off the star and is a single forward cone: members run 0-45 cm at 0.2-10.4 deg, and its acceptance plot has NO non-member circle anywhere in the window, so there is nothing contiguous left unclaimed. Every unowned segment in the event is at >=65 deg from its axis (14028 at 112 deg, 14004 at 176 deg, the rest sub-4 MeV stubs at 65-154 deg), so I see no under-clustering; the member set is one apex, one direction, so no over-clustering. Caveat I did not test: the detached start plus the reco calling 60026 (15.6 cm, 2.9 deg, absorbed pass4_prox) pdg 211 and 60024 pdg 2212 are PID statements inside the shower body -- for a 300 MeV EM object a MIP-like stem PID is expected and I make no PID claim. Only 1 shower is in scope; the other 8 are 3.6 MeV and below and I did not look at them. Single gamma with no partner anywhere in the reco, so the absence of a pi0 group is a missing second photon, not a mis-pairing.
